title: The Maximum Codimension of a Salem Submanifold
summary: We determine a geometric condition necessary and sufficient for an $m$-dimensional manifold in Euclidean space to support a probability measure $μ$ satisfying the Fourier decay bound $|\widehatμ(ζ)| \lesssim_\varepsilon |ζ|^{\varepsilon - m/2}$ for all $\varepsilon > 0$. As a result, for each $m > 0$, we explicitly determine the largest codimension of an $m$-dimensional smooth submanifold $M$ of Euclidean space which is a Salem set.
